namespace = fixture

# A commented reference the scanner must never see:
# has_star_flag = fixture_beacon

event = {
	id = fixture.1
	hide_window = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	trigger = {
		any_system = {
			has_star_flag = fixture_beacon
		}
	}
	immediate = {
		set_global_flag = fixture_beacon_seen
	}
}

event = {
	id = fixture.2
	is_triggered_only = yes
	trigger = {
		any_system = {
			has_star_flag = fixture_region
		}
	}
}

event = {
	id = fixture.3
	is_triggered_only = yes
	immediate = {
		event_target:fixture_planet_target = {
			set_planet_flag = fixture_seen
		}
		# The same event reaches the same system a second way.
		if = {
			limit = { has_star_flag = fixture_probe }
			set_global_flag = fixture_probe_seen
		}
	}
}

event = {
	id = fixture.4
	is_triggered_only = yes
	immediate = {
		event_target:fixture_country_target = {
			set_country_flag = fixture_seen
		}
	}
}

# Day one: the game-start sweep, the branch it rules out, and two events it
# fires: one a month out, one the next day.
event = {
	id = fixture.5
	is_triggered_only = yes
	immediate = {
		every_system = {
			limit = { NOT = { exists = starbase } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_star_flag = fixture_claimed
					has_global_flag = fixture_map_spawned
				}
				create_starbase = {
					size = starbase_hut
					owner = event_target:fixture_empire
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_star_flag = fixture_scoped
					is_capital = yes
				}
				set_owner = prev
			}
		}
		country_event = { id = fixture.6 days = 40 }
		country_event = { id = fixture.7 days = 1 }
	}
}

event = {
	id = fixture.6
	is_triggered_only = yes
	immediate = {
		every_system = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_star_flag = fixture_late }
				set_owner = event_target:fixture_empire
			}
		}
	}
}

event = {
	id = fixture.7
	is_triggered_only = yes
	immediate = {
		every_system = {
			limit = { has_star_flag = fixture_outer }
			every_system = {
				limit = { has_star_flag = fixture_inner }
				create_starbase = {
					size = starbase_hut
					owner = event_target:fixture_empire
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Day one: a wormhole whose two ends are systems a star flag picks out, a
# ruined gateway on every system carrying its flag, and a pair the game
# places wherever it likes.
event = {
	id = fixture.8
	is_triggered_only = yes
	immediate = {
		random_system = {
			limit = { has_star_flag = wh_a }
			save_event_target_as = wh_a_sys
		}
		random_system = {
			limit = { has_star_flag = wh_b }
			spawn_natural_wormhole = {
				bypass_type = wormhole
				random_pos = no
				orbit_angle = 360
			}
			event_target:wh_a_sys = {
				spawn_natural_wormhole = {
					bypass_type = wormhole
					random_pos = no
					orbit_angle = 360
				}
				link_wormholes = prev
			}
		}
	}
}

event = {
	id = fixture.9
	is_triggered_only = yes
	immediate = {
		every_system = {
			limit = { has_star_flag = gate_here }
			spawn_megastructure = {
				type = gateway_ruined
			}
		}
	}
}

event = {
	id = fixture.10
	is_triggered_only = yes
	immediate = {
		random_system = {
			limit = { has_natural_wormhole = no }
			random_system = {
				limit = {
					has_natural_wormhole = no
					distance = {
						source = prev
						max_distance = 200
					}
				}
				prev = {
					spawn_natural_wormhole = {
						bypass_type = wormhole
						random_pos = yes
						orbit_angle = 360
					}
				}
				spawn_natural_wormhole = {
					bypass_type = wormhole
					random_pos = yes
					orbit_angle = 360
				}
				link_wormholes = prev
			}
		}
	}
}

# A mouth spawned back through `prev`: it lands on the system of the loop the
# inner one was entered from, not on the inner one's.
event = {
	id = fixture.12
	is_triggered_only = yes
	immediate = {
		random_system = {
			limit = { has_star_flag = wh_prev }
			random_system = {
				limit = { has_natural_wormhole = no }
				prev = {
					spawn_natural_wormhole = {
						bypass_type = wormhole
						random_pos = no
						orbit_angle = 360
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# A gateway spawned through scopes this reader cannot follow: the system it
# lands on is the country's capital, not the system the loop is on.
event = {
	id = fixture.13
	is_triggered_only = yes
	immediate = {
		every_system = {
			limit = { has_star_flag = gate_elsewhere }
			random_country = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = fixture_empire }
				solar_system = {
					spawn_megastructure = {
						type = gateway_final
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
